prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: detailed 2D game enemy redesign concept sheet, NOT a screenshot or a scene, NOT final animation atlas.
Reference image 1 is the existing whole original Crystal Depth Guardian; preserve its recognizable cyan crystal/charcoal stone identity and central round gold chest core. Redraw substantially cleaner and more detailed, matching a polished hand-painted top-down cozy fantasy farming RPG. View camera slightly elevated, orthographic, full body, no perspective ground plane.
Composition: landscape 3 columns by 2 rows, exactly six isolated full-body poses of the SAME creature at consistent size. Top row: facing camera/south, strict left/west profile, strict right/east profile. Bottom row: back/north, frontal ground-slam windup with both fists raised, frontal slam follow-through with fists on the ground. Leave wide empty transparent gutters and generous padding so every head crystal, hand, and foot is completely inside its area. Keep feet aligned to a shared baseline within each row. No adjacent fragments, no cropped edges, no cut bodies.
Maintain a broad readable silhouette, two arms, two legs, clear joints and recognizable face, bright cyan eyes, restrained glowing crystal accents; textured carved dark stone armor, teal/cyan faceted crystals, gentle cool shadows. Painterly clean high-resolution outlines and material detail, crisp at small in-game size; no coarse pixel grid, no purple chroma fringe, no white outline, no glow halo. Not glossy 3D, not photorealistic.
Transparent background with real alpha, no ground/shadow ellipse, no labels, no letters, no UI, no watermark.
Variant A — armored sentinel: retain the original knight-like design, a sculpted stone helmet and broad layered shoulder armor, fewer larger cyan crystal growths, readable carved plates, warm antique-gold chest ring with a turquoise-lit core. Disciplined compact proportions, slightly taller than the player, detailed but clear and practical as a reusable sprite.
